inspiration: One key, three modes: hold, toggle and set as a small state machine (src/main/java/com/camerakeys/CameraKeysPlugin.java:448-495).
A preset is cancelled only after a short tick lockout and only when the user moves it past a threshold (CameraKeysPlugin.java:82-86, :515-520).
State resets on viewport change and on settings change, so no zoom gets stuck (CameraKeysPlugin.java:286-291, :318-323).
A corner indicator shows only while the mode is active (CameraKeysOverlay.java:46).
Four direction keys call one client script with a direction value (CameraKeysListener.java:68; CameraKeysPlugin.java:508).
A hold-mode state is released when the window loses focus, so input cannot stick (CameraKeysPlugin.java:272-278).
